text: This report includes an update on staffing matters, including (i) a snapshot of CreateTO's human resources as at the end of the third quarter 2021, and (ii) Management actions in response to the December 2020 Employee Engagement Survey.

The CreateTO - Human Resources Committee: 1. Requested the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO to report to the January 11, 2022 meeting of the Board of Directors of CreateTO with an update on staffing and compensation for CreateTO.
